seoTitle: Cookie Consent Banner Checklist: 12 Points to Review
metaDescription: Tick what your cookie banner does and get a list of points to review: reject button, pre-ticked boxes, withdrawal and more. Free checklist, not legal advice.
intro: A 12-point self-check for cookie consent banners that lists the points you ticked off and the ones to review, with the reason for each.
why:
Most complaints about cookie banners are about the same few things: no easy reject, accept and reject styled differently, boxes ticked in advance, trackers firing before a choice, and no way to change your mind later.

This checklist turns those points into tick boxes. It does not look at your site: the answers are your own statements, so test the real banner with dev tools. Rules differ by country and change, so use it as a prompt for a proper review, not as proof of compliance.
howTo: Open your site in a private window and look at the banner.
Tick each statement that is true for your banner.
Read the review list and the reason given for each unticked item.
Fix the items and test again with the Network tab open.

faq.q: Does this prove my banner is compliant?
faq.a: No. It is a prompt for review. Compliance depends on law, country and the real behaviour of your scripts.

faq.q: Where do the points come from?
faq.a: From common points in EU data protection authority guidance on cookie banners and from GDPR Art. 4(11) and Art. 7. Rules and enforcement vary.
